environment.fixtures: temporary synthetic SQLite and local HTTP/Chromium; existing private databases untouched

behavior: Profile JSON and backup exports omit recognized credential key families and enumerated HTTP authentication aliases at any nested mapping depth.
Work authorization and ordinary answers survive; export redaction never changes persisted inputs.
Generated file reads cap bytes despite growth after stat; uploaded reads stop at recorded size plus one byte and recheck size/checksum.
Accumulated document-file JSON is bounded; oversized upload metadata is rejected before opening the file.
API backup failure returns fixed error without attachment or partial payload; repaired-file retry and database reopen succeed.
Connected Chromium downloads remain readable/profile-scoped; synthetic credential markers are absent from downloaded exports.
